31K likes, 148 comments - taapsee on October 30, 2026: "An extraordinary evening that celebrated ambition, bold vision, and Punjab’s rising presence on the global stage! ✨

The @gbrealtyofficial × @gbjacobandcoresidences Grand Gala marked a defining milestone in Punjab’s luxury real estate landscape, celebrating the arrival of Punjab’s first branded residences in collaboration with global icons Salman Khan and Jacob & Co.

A heartfelt thank you to @igurinderbhatti for having me there to witness such a remarkable occasion.

As GB rightly said, “Eh Punjab hai, ithe jo kari da, vadda kari da!” 🥂

#Grandgala #GBRealty #JacobAndCo #GurinderBhatti #BrandedResidences".

But beyond the numbers, it is her willingness to take chances that continues to define her filmography. Swipe through our digital shoot featuring the actor.
